scope: All 43 numbered result rows from the surviving PropertyAuctions AID 579 grid for the 13 October 2008 Savills Commercial sale. The archived first-party Savills page identifies the sale date, states a total of 43 lots across three catalogue pages and exposes lots 1-20 on page 1. Those first 20 rows reconcile to the secondary grid; its Development label also restores the blank first-party type cell for lot 5. The secondary grid exposes every numbered lot 1-43 exactly once and reports Offered: 43. Street addresses and postcodes are not exposed and remain null; lot 25's unpublished locality remains null.
completion_scope: all numbered lots 1-43 appear exactly once in the result grid and reconcile to both the first-party total of 43 and the secondary Offered: 43 denominator
